bio: Marquita Bradshaw (born January 12, 1974) is an American environmentalist, activist, and political candidate. She became the first African American woman to win a major political party nomination in any statewide race in Tennessee as Democratic nominee in the 2020 United States Senate election. Bradshaw was also the Democratic nominee in the 2026 Senate election.
